visual_requirements.description: Separate eyewitness forms: A slender muscular about-seven-foot man-shaped black creature with white avian wings, face indiscernible except red eyes; B about-six-foot man-shaped body without obvious head/neck, shining red eyes in body, unmoving wings in flight.
Flight accompanying fleeing car and source shining/glowing red eyes, no invented electricity disruption visuals or bridge curse.
Point Pleasant road/TNT former munitions area, night with car headlights; no cinematic/game Mothman design.

A.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, strong silhouette at 200 pixels, tactile painterly textures, cinematic low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, magical energy ribbons or floating runes; source fidelity and respect for living traditions.
ANATOMY: MOTHMAN only the Scarberry eyewitness version: a SLENDER MUSCULAR MAN-SHAPED BLACK CREATURE about SEVEN FEET tall, TWO long WHITE AVIAN WINGS with feather structure, humanlike two arms and two legs, TWO red glowing eyes. The face cannot be discerned due to hypnotic red eyes; hide facial features in dark body, no clear nose/beak or mouth, no invented headless torso claim in this version. Black nonhuman shadow-textured body with no exposed sexual anatomy; not naked human model. [mothman-c07/c08] The original sightings have avian NOT moth/insect features, so NO antennas, mandibles, insect wings, furry moth-face, demon horns or armor. [mothman-c01] MOMENT: Take flight right over a fleeing period car, wings wide and tilted diagonally, legs swept backward, red eyes stare directly down at the viewer inside car; threatening active pursuit rather than standing on roof. POWER: documented flight keeping pace with a fast car and eyes glowing red, no beams or laser eyes, no magic aura. [mothman-c09/c07] SCALE & CAMERA: close low road-level view by car windshield, creature in near foreground fills 80 percent, WHITE wings clearly dominate sides with tips allowed off frame, car roof edge tiny at bottom as natural man-size comparison; do not giantify creature beyond perspective. LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm car headlight source shines upward across white wing feathers and black torso; localized red eyes only documented glow, wet night atmosphere, deep shadows. SURFACE: rough dark body texture, ivory white feathers, rain flecks, asphalt. SETTING: Point Pleasant night road near abandoned WWII TNT munitions works c07, one dark ruined industrial doorway far edge. MOOD: uncanny dangerous cryptid pursuit, no superhero, no movie/game design.
